defects.summary: MustCarryNoFlags also refuses a plan whose Cwd is CwdKind.Root, which goes beyond decision 3; deviation 36 lists only Leading, Flags and AddDirs, so the recorded deviation is incomplete, and the extra test APlanRootedInTheCheckout_IsRefusedForKimi is not in the plan's deviations either.
Decision 2 says each row's note carries the version 2.1.1, but the kimi web row's note does not name it (only measuredWith.version does).

S5.6.7's refused-before-the-launch arm does not assert that the row's coai-question scratch is removed; this gap is recorded only in the out-of-scope research/module_tests.md, not in the plan's deviations.

Some assertions are loose: S5.5.1 only checks that --cwd contains own/tree and that the home's parent starts with the coai-vh root, not exactly <scratch>/own/tree and coai-vh/<8>; S5.5.4 checks only that the home's parent ends with 'own', with no kh-<10 hex> name and no check that it is inside the check's scratch.

S5.6.2 is the existing TheVectorsActuallyLoaded test, but a redundant TheVectorsCoverKimi was added; the Records doc comment still names only the question-consultant and Vibe records; and the rename of TheFlags_..._NothingElseFlagged is not recorded.
The Scopes helper and StandIn() are copied a second and third time (they already exist in AKimiConsultationScenarioTests), not shared.

Deviation 39 records that the project's selected rules were not read in full, and deviation 33 records that the flag refusal (S5.6.6) was never watched red at its own line, so the red-first process was only partly followed.
